title: Lumin Glen
safeHtml:
Lumin Glen is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is the Westernmost Sub-District of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-07.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing
    • 2.1 Public Housing
    • 2.2 Home Ownership Scheme
  • 3 Transport
    • 3.1 Major Roads
  • 4 Citations and References

History[]

The name of this Sub-District originates from the fact that this District features the most amount of land that is not within Snow-related Biome and gave an abundance of trees.

Due to the remoteness of this location, the Developer of Asylum has decided to build a large Public Estate of 31 separate Houses that is also divided into three phases for ease of administration, with a Shopping Mall at the center that is inspired by Queen's Hill Estate. Moreover, Lumin Glen also features a lot of recreational facilities, including a sports center and a swimming pool. This way, Lumin Glen residents would not have to worry about long travel times whenever they leave home.

As Lumin Glen does not feature any Private Housing, it also means that this Sub-District has the highest ratio of Public Housing and Public Estates.

Luxter Line is Line Number 7 of NR Los Sengas Division Standard Railway. This line has 20 stations, and was established on April 6 2015. It runs between Bufly Island and Mangkhut Sound.

Description []

Luxter Line is one of the auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It generally runs in the east-west orientation at the north of Downtown. The line starts from the Sava Area and passes through the Sava Channel. Afterwards, it enters Youngsters, Glacier and skirts the edge of Ingress before reaching Internal Sea.

This route is represented by Dark Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 7.

Currently, this route is 30.93 km long, with a total of 20 stations.

History[]

  • S1E2: Bufly Island - Upwell Sand
  • S1E11: Bufly Island - Rover Down
  • S1E19: Bufly Island - Ingress South
  • S2E12: Bufly Island - Ingress Diamond
  • S3E7: Bufly Island - Sand Martin
  • PS4P2: Bufly Island - Mangkhut Sound

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend from Sand Martin Checkpoint to Yowah. Completed
(Chapter: PS4P2)
Extend Northeast from Mangkhut Sound Station to Daisy Island Station along the North Coast of Yowah. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend further to the east to Abunest in Torrent and turn north to Daisy Island Station. TBC

Districts Served[]

  • West Metropolis Archipelago
    • Bufly Island
  • Sava
  • Youngsters
  • Glacier
  • Ingress
  • Internal Sea

Line Charcteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Despite being Route Number 7, this line is the second line in Los Sengas Division to be established, as well as the first line to NOT pass through Metropolis Terminal.
  • The permanent Terminus at the west end is located at West Metropolis Archipelago (Bufly Island). This station, as well as the two subsequent Stations (West Shoal, Sava Canyon, designed as cross-platform interchanges) shares section with West Ring Line. This increases the convenience of interchanging between this line and West Ring Line.
  • The section between Rover Down (Exclusive) and Ingress South has a set of sidings that shares with Ingress Line.
  • Both ends of this line are interchanges (Bufly Island, Sand Martin).
  • This line features 8 consecutive interchanges from North Mountain Station to Ingress Diamond Station. If in-train interchanges and transfers to other railways are considered, all stations on this line except for Bluewhale Island are interchanges.

Fun Facts[]

  • Luxter Line features Through Services with West Ring Line at Upwell Sand Station.
  • Most of the route between Rover Down (Exclusive) and Thin River (Exclusive) shares structures with Route 3.
  • This line may extend to Abunest East Station and Daisy Island Station of East Ring Line in the future.

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 3150th page of this wiki.
  • This Station is the Second Station in the Nazca Railway in which the word "Line" is used as the name of a Station, with the first instance being Three Line Island Station. With that being said:
    • This Station is the first station in which the word "Line" is used at the end of the English Name of a Station. This may cause confusion as the word "Line" is usually used to describe a Railway Line instead of the Station in itself despite the fact that the Full Name of this Station is "Magma Line Station".[3]
    • Coincidentally, a line that starts with the letter "M" (Mike Line) serves this station.
  • While this station mainly serves the relevant development areas in Asylum and Winsol, the station is geographically located in Snowty.
  • Due to Geographical constraints, the Arcgo Line Platforms and the Snowty Line, Mike Line Platforms are not connected by Elevator.
  • This station is the last station to be built in 2025.

History[]

  • December 25 2025: This Station began construction.
  • December 27 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • December 28 2025: This station began services alongside Snowty Line and Mike Line, but Arcgo Line Platforms remain reserved.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "From Abyss to Aether".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Stormwrought Dominion 02:59

Fun Facts[]

  • Being the 444th Station, this station is the fourth station to feature three digits of a single number, with the first three being Purple Gate Station, Longwington Station and Glaciss Station.
  • If Pre-Season 4 Stations are considered, this station is the last station to be built in Season 3.
  • The Color Scheme of this station alludes to the leaves of the Mangosteen, which also coincides with the fact that this station is situated to the north of Mangkhut Station.
  • This Station is the last station to be built with Basic Station Facilities (Brewing Stations, Workshops, Repair Stations, Enchantment Stations) as the Railway Builder mentioned that new stations built on or after Season 4 would no longer feature such facilities.[4]

History[]

  • March 15 2024: This Station began construction.
  • March 21 2024: This Station completed construction.
  • March 22 2024: This Station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that Typhoon Mangkhut made landfall near Hong Kong and caused Hong Kong to host the Typhoon Signal No. 10 at the time it was built. Moreover, the color scheme of this station also alludes to the Mangosteen.
  • This station has been rebuilt once. In the previous incarnation, this station only had two exits, one concourse, and four shops. However, currently, this station has eight exits, with connections to Luxter Line Mangkhut Sound Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station marks the first instance since Java Beach Station Platform 4 in which Curved End Platforms are built, also making it the first such instance in Season 4.
  • This station is named after the Element Hub Transit Station of the Same Name, which is in turn inspired by the Manchester United Football Club. The Station Icon and the Tree Trunk Design on the Platform Control Board are inspired by the giant Tree Trunk at the Center of that station.
  • This Station shares structure, exit numbers and fare zones with Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Mansgrove Station. Nazca Railway makes use of Platforms 1-2 and Exits B-E, whereas Element Hub Transit makes use of Platforms 3-4 and Exit A. The two Stations are connected by Exits F-H, which are all located within the Fare Zone.
  • The Station Codes of this Station and Mangkhut Sound Station (Mangkhut Station for Element Hub Transit) are reversed with each other. This is due to the fact that, as Mangkhut Station at Element Hub Transit is built earlier than Mansgrove Station, and with both stations having a single English Word as its station name, Mangkhut makes use of the first three English Letters (MANgkhut), whereas Mansgrove has to use different English Letters (MAnSgrove). On the other hand, while Nazca Railway's Mangkhut Sound Station is also built earlier, as the Full Name of that station is Mangkhut Sound, Nazca Railway needs to use MAS as the Station Code (MAngkhut Sound), compounded with the fact that the Code MAN has never been used in Nazca Railway prior to this station, the Station Code for this station becomes MAN (MANsgrove). In short:
    • For Nazca Railway, Mangkhut Sound Station's Code is MAS, and Mansgrove Station's Code is MAN;
    • For Element Hub Transit, Mangkhut Station's Code is MAN, and Mansgrove Station's Code is MAS.

title: Maritime Vista
safeHtml:
Maritime Vista is one of the Sub-Districts of Winsol. It is located at the East Side of North Winsol, and its District Code is 29-20.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing
    • 2.1 Public Housing
    • 2.2 Home Ownership Scheme
    • 2.3 Private Housing
  • 3 Transport
    • 3.1 Major Roads
  • 4 Fun Facts
  • 5 Citations and References

History[]

The name of this Sub-District originates from the fact that the many tourists came to this area to look at waves despite the turbulent nature of the waves in the nearby vicinity which had claimed many lives.

Maritime Vista was not a part of the Asylum New Town, but as the developer of Asylum also began developing Winsol, the area in Winsol to the north of Route 18 is now seen as a part of Asylum New Town. Vermillion Stone is the east section of the Extension.

title: Mark 4
safeHtml:
Mark 4 was a form of Lottery in Project Nazca and Los Sengas.

History[]

Betting Method[]

  • The Mark 4 is completely free.
  • Originally, each player could only bet once. However, eventually, players could bet twice due to the low probability of winning the lottery.
  1. Take the Book and Quill, and fill in as follows:
Mark 4 (<Phase>)
<No.1> <No.2> <No.3> <No.4> (Fill in any number ranging from 1~24)
Minecraft User Name
  1. Write down the Following at the Book Title:
Mark 4 (<Phase>)
  1. Go to Any ticket station and put the book into a chest to finish betting.

Winning the Lottery[]

  • If you get two numbers or above, you win the lottery.
  • People who win the Lottery can go to any Nazca Railway Station to get its Station Souvenir.
